cases.query: 先进制程的定义是什么？只给出术语库定义。
cases.answer:
先进制程（Advanced Process Node）的定义：晶体管关键尺寸进入7nm及以下的芯片制造工艺，包括FinFET和GAA晶体管架构[1]。制程越先进，芯片性能越高、功耗越低，但研发和资本支出呈指数级增长[1]。其技术代际为先进制程（≤7nm）[1]。

补充相关概念：制程节点（Process Node）是以纳米（nm）为单位的芯片制造工艺代际标识，如28nm、7nm、3nm；数值越小代表晶体管密度越高、性能越强[2]。

cases.query: What is hybrid bonding? Give only the terminology database definition.
cases.answer: Hybrid bonding is a bump-less wafer-level/chip-level direct bonding technology that simultaneously bonds copper contacts and dielectric surfaces to achieve vertical interconnects with extremely small pitch (<1μm)[1]. It is classified as an advanced packaging technology generation[1]. Commercially, hybrid bonding is positioned as the ultimate packaging solution for ultra-high-performance 3D ICs (such as AMD 3D V-Cache and high-end HBM4), with interconnect density more than 10x higher than conventional bumps; its commercial barrier lies in extremely high particle control and surface planarity requirements, driving demand for wafer bonding equipment makers (EVG, ASMPT) and CMP materials[1]. Related concepts include advanced packaging, 3D IC, HBM, and wafer bonding; related companies include EV Group, ASMPT, TSMC, and Sony[1].
